The main takeaway from our work is that

theta activity during presleep memory encoding is an important predictor of subsequent overnight consolidation and that it might be a missing link in understanding how memory consolidation is influenced by sleep.
the link between sleep spindling and overnight performance change might be mediated by pre-sleep processes.
